technicalLimits: Native lock was refused: four exercised routes used supported drag fallback, not successful pointer lock.
The riverside initial pose passes framing, but the post-native endpoint and all12 subsequent frames obscure the centered torso behind roof/wall.
Manual 12-frame sequences are 5 production steps apart; no duplicate adjacent pixels does not prove smooth motion or absence of shimmer.
Raw GL confirms actual post/shadow/ink work, not individual-pixel skin/depth correctness or selected-caster attribution.
No in-session resize/DPR transitions, GPU context loss/recovery, complete faction action matrix or sustained real-device thermal test.
No real mobile/integrated hardware; no matched counter-disabled run or causal performance improvement claim.
12 lifecycle samples returned target bytes to0, not all resources to0; joint fixture did not have a separate instrumented teardown cycle.
FXAA warnings point to the unmodified three addon; rendered same-post crops showed softened thin edges but no identified corruption. Driver portability remains open.
